title: deer-flow.trading_research.error v1
description: Structured failure from Deer Flow's TradingResearchBusConsumer when a research-ticker command cannot be parsed or its research pipeline fails.

ticker.description: Requested ticker, or the emitter's 'unknown' fallback when parsing failed.

message.description: Exception detail, truncated by the emitter.

run_id.description: UUID assigned to a research run; omitted for command parse failures.
